description: This is a test class 'TimesheetDaoTest' for the 'TimesheetDao' data access object in the context of OrangeHRM's time management plugin. It contains unit tests for creating, retrieving, updating, and verifying timesheet-related entities such as Timesheet, TimesheetItem, and TimesheetActionLog, as well as testing report and filter functionalities.

classes.name: TimesheetDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for TimesheetDao, testing CRUD operations, report generation, and other business logic related to timesheets in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates a TimesheetDao instance, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testAddTimesheet
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new Timesheet entity.

methods.name: testDuplicateTimesheet
methods.description: Verifies the existence of a timesheet on a specific start date for an employee.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Tests retrieval of timesheet action logs for a specific timesheet.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Tests adding a new action log to a timesheet.

methods.name: testGetMyTimesheets
methods.description: Tests retrieval of timesheets filtered by employee and date range.

methods.name: testIsDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks for duplicate timesheet items for given project, activity, and timesheet.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetItem
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new TimesheetItem.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a TimesheetItem by timesheet ID and item ID.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Timesheet by its ID.

methods.name: testSaveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsExceptionCase
methods.description: Tests exception handling when saving invalid timesheet items with inconsistent project activity relation.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Tests fetching list of employee timesheets based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of employee timesheets matching certain filters.

methods.name: testGetLatestTimesheet
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the latest default timesheet for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportAndTotalHours
methods.description: Tests generating employee report data and total hours with various filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Verifies count of timesheet items matching report filters.

methods.name: testTimesheetAvailability
methods.description: Checks for existence of a timesheet item with specific project, timesheet, activity, and date parameters.
